about: Zlecenie W: wizualizacje kamieni przez Codex headless. Ścieżki plików względem katalogu data/ w repo; pierwszy istniejący wygrywa (HD z eksportu FB, potem pliki w gicie: data/legacy, data/wzorce). Wzorce kolorów to prawdziwe zdjęcia kart katalogu z naturalnymi kamieniami.

rubin.kolor_en: deep red with a slight purplish tone, rich and velvety, darker in the pavilion with bright red flashes; not orange, not pink, not candy-like glass

szafir.kolor_en: deep royal-to-cornflower blue, velvety, darker towards the edges; not electric neon blue, not purple-black

szafir-granatowy.kolor_en: dark, deep blue sapphire leaning towards navy, velvety and saturated but dark; darker than cornflower or royal blue, not black, not electric, not purple
szafir-granatowy.wzorce_uwaga_en: The target is noticeably darker than these references – navy rather than cornflower blue.

szmaragd.kolor_en: deep, slightly bluish green with a soft velvety glow and subtle natural inclusions (jardin); not neon green, not bottle-glass green

ametyst.kolor_en: medium-to-deep purple with violet and slightly reddish flashes; not pink, not greyish lilac

topaz-jasnoniebieski.kolor_en: clear light-to-medium sky blue, bright and transparent, clearly lighter than London blue topaz; not turquoise, not pale aquamarine

topaz-london-blue.kolor_en: dark steel-grey navy blue with inky depth and muted saturation; not bright royal blue

bialy-diament.kolor_en: colourless, icy white diamond: crisp neutral white with lively brilliance and subtle rainbow fire; no tint picked up from the yellow gold and no trace of the previous blue colour
bialy-diament.wzorce_uwaga_en: The reference diamonds are emerald-cut: take ONLY their colour (colourless, icy white, no warm or blue tint) and the character of their brilliance; keep the round brilliant cut and the facets of the stone in IMAGE 1.
